comparison.objective: Unload objects from a rocking tray, versus tune and lock a robot-axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Motion-compensated grasping and removal differ from hex-key engagement, fine collar rotation, counterholding, and response-based adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Successful unloading without loss differs from two safe repeatable stops and witness-tested lock retention. Record has no specs or loss/damage thresholds.
comparison.reason: The record tests extraction from a moving support, not mechanical commissioning.
